children.text: Participants
ThinkByte: Shubham Barbaile, Pavan, Satish Chitturi, Harsha Thota, Charan, Sujan Deta
Key Takeaways
The team discussed the need to prepare for a presentation tomorrow, focusing on video content and ensuring all necessary materials are ready.
There is a requirement to generate 6,000 leads by January, with a current monthly target of 2,000 leads to meet this goal.
Concerns were raised about the effectiveness of current ad campaigns, with suggestions to optimize spending and possibly create new accounts if necessary.
The team needs to finalize and implement specific action items for website updates, including content and design changes, by the 16th.
Integration of Superphone with other platforms like Wix is ongoing, and there is a need to ensure all leads are being effectively tracked and contacted.
The team discussed the need to prepare for a meeting tomorrow, focusing on customer engagement rather than franchising.
There is a requirement to generate 6,000 leads by January, with a current target of 2,000 leads per month.
Concerns were raised about website leads not being consistently contacted, with only 12 out of 48 leads updated in the system.
The team plans to create a detailed list of action items for website changes, emphasizing the need for specific tasks rather than generic descriptions.
Integration of Superphone with Wix and other CRMs is being explored to improve communication through SMS, WhatsApp, and email.
Action Items
Suggested that one person should take on a task to complete it while another reviews it, and once finished, the action items could be added to the daily tracker for monitoring.

Explained that after conducting a deep dive, there would be a second set of action items, followed by a third set related to the website, emphasizing the importance of breaking down tasks into smaller components.
Pavan
Update and analyze lead integration with Superphone
Coordinate on lead integration and follow-up strategies.
Confirm timelines with the team and share with Harsha.
Develop website action items
Implement action items and integration strategies for the website and Superphone.
Prepare content plans
Harsha Thota
Monitor and optimize campaign performance
Review lead integration
Collaborate to improve website and lead integration.
Submit the Google Ads after some time for review.
Implement and organize action plans for the website and lead management.
Share the details of what happened with Sujan.
Revamp the website and break down the action items into multiple sets after a deep dive.
Establish and organize website and content plans
Presentation Preparation
Preparing for presentation focusing on new designer, specifically on carousel lights and video content. Sujan and Shubhrant will attend.
Preparation for Meeting/Presentation
Discussion on preparing for presentation involving carousel lights, video content, new engagement strategies, franchise strategy shifts, focus on Sujan application development.
Harsha emphasized no additional preparation required from Pavan or Sujan, focusing internal strategy discussions.
Pavan and Harsha confirmed readiness for the meeting, with Pavan planning to observe and report back on proceedings.
Video Content Creation
Focus on creating video content for presentation, internal use, with emphasis on cutting larger videos into smaller segments for effective presentation and communication.
Harsha requested the team cut larger videos into smaller segments for effective presentation and communication, aiming to have video content ready for the upcoming meeting.
Engagement Strategy
Current engagement strategies require reevaluation to align with future objectives and application focus.
Concentrate new engagement discussions on Sujan's application development, align strategies with future business goals.
Shift focus from franchising to new engagement strategies, emphasizing development of Sujan's application and future engagement plans.
Integration with Superphone and Wix
Manual uploads of leads were suggested to ensure proper follow-up, with emphasis on managing high-intent leads and ensuring they are integrated into systems for effective engagement.
Technical issues with integration affecting lead management and tracking in Superphone.
Efforts reintegrate Superphone with Wix ensure high-intent leads are properly managed, manually uploaded due technical issues. Aim improve lead tracking and conversion.
Lead Generation and Franchise Strategy
Target generate 6,000 leads by January, with focus on re-engagement, not heavy emphasis franchising discussions. Current lead generation inconsistent, requires improvement.
Manual uploads of leads into Superphone were suggested to ensure proper follow-up and track lead conversion.
Inconsistent lead generation and lack of comprehensive updates on leads touched in Superphone.
Discussed integrating Wix with Superphone improve lead management, re-engagement, with focus on high-intent leads.
Lead Generation
Target: Generate 6,000 leads by January, requiring 2,000 leads each month. Current shortfall: only 2,000 leads generated. Need to expedite processes meet targets.
Insufficient leads; current strategy not yielding enough qualified leads.
Increase lead generation efforts, ensure consistency in qualified leads to meet targets.
Inconsistency in qualified leads; numbers fluctuate between 40-50.
Integration Efforts
Previous integration was ineffective, leading to missed opportunities in lead management.
Reintegration of Wix with Superphone underway due to issues with previous integration. Emphasis on ensuring real-time lead data flow.
Manual uploads of leads necessary due to incomplete data transfer.
Prioritize completing integration with Wix and Superphone to improve lead management efficiency and ensure real-time data updates.
Campaign Management
Inefficient ad spend due to multiple copies and inadequate budget allocation, leading to higher costs for certain demographics like English speakers.
Streamline, prioritize ad sets with better performance; focus on ads to optimize budget spend; use existing design elements ensure consistency.
Manage Facebook, Google Ads campaigns by focusing on high-performing ad sets, ensuring budget allocation efficiency, and minimizing costs.
Ad Performance and Optimization

Focus on optimizing Facebook ad performance by managing ad copies, budgets effectively. Discussions on creating new creatives, starting retargeting campaigns, ensuring ads are live, spending correctly.
Issues with ad spending, live status affecting performance and lead generation.
Harsha instructed the team to ensure ads are running effectively and make necessary adjustments to improve engagement and lead generation, including creating new ad copies and managing budgets.
Website Updates
Update and optimize website and landing pages with specific focus on design improvements, content updates, and optimizing user experience. Need clear actionable items.
Stagnation in progress with unclear action items, leading to delays in website updates.
Use existing design elements for consistency; create specific action items; assign tasks to developers. Prioritize design completion by specified dates.
Website Development
Pavan and Satish discussed website updates, changes, focusing on landing pages, content, templates. Emphasis on using existing design elements and breaking down tasks into actionable items.
Lack of clear action items, timelines for website updates; need for specific changes to be listed and tracked.
Prioritize website changes and create specific action items to ensure effective task management, with existing design elements reused as much as possible.
Segment tasks into smaller, manageable items and assign them for better tracking and execution.
Content Plan and Management
Development of content plan for Sujan, including video testimonials, ongoing website development. Harsha emphasized need for clear content plans with timelines, action items for effective execution.
Ensure content plans are broken into actionable items with assigned timelines for effective tracking and execution, focusing on ongoing efforts like video testimonials and website updates.
